app.title: Enigmatica
app.tagline: Decode the manga, one chapter at a time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: 12 HOURS LEFT TO LIVE
chapters.description: Chapter 1 now chains indexing, board extraction, and a guided Hill-cipher reveal.

puzzles.title: Read the numbered letters
puzzles.prompt:
A strip of letters appears above a row of numbers.
Letters:   ARTOYGDWEASOTUIBOVIAFFQKJI
Positions: 06 09 03 03 04 08 04 02 24
Use the numbers as direct indexes into the letter strip and enter the decoded phrase.
puzzles.hint: Treat the strip as 1-based indexed: 1=A, 2=R, 3=T, and so on.

puzzles.title: Find the warning in the board
puzzles.prompt:
A second clue uses a larger board reference.
Board:
01: VL1NK JOLQ3
02: QCOSF IA4K1
03: 1MV1F PEGBZ
04: TARM2 5YFOX
05: KQWKX OAPPQ
06: EU3FL DYZPM
07: MZXIY OYZEX
08: XYMHQ OUNGL
09: I1QOF BNDEH
10: 443VL UPDME
11: AWELB 21NB2
12: EAB2H BUOJ3
Source clue: 14 34 24 69
Use the board to recover the four-letter warning.
puzzles.hint: Read the board as a grid. The first three letters sit on row 4 and spell T, R, A.

puzzles.title: Use the Hill-cipher inverse matrix
puzzles.prompt:
This chapter step uses a two-character Hill cipher over the alphabet ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ12345.
Medium mode gives you the inverse matrix, so you do not need to derive it yourself.
Character values: A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25, 1=26, 2=27, 3=28, 4=29, 5=30
Use this inverse matrix:
  [12  6]
  [12  2]
Treat each block XY as the column vector [x, y]^T, multiply modulo 31, then convert the result back into characters.
Ciphertext blocks: QB RA EO ME
Decode all four blocks, join the plaintext, then remove the trailing filler character '3'.
puzzles.hint: Worked example: QB -> [16,1]. Applying the inverse matrix gives [12,8], which maps to MI.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: 3 HOURS LEFT TO LIVE
chapters.description: Chapter 2 introduces a Polybius checkerboard puzzle with row-column decoding.

puzzles.title: Read the Polybius checkerboard
puzzles.prompt:
A Polybius checkerboard stores each letter as two digits: row first, then column.
Board:
    1 2 3 4 5
1:  A B C D E
2:  F G H I K
3:  L M N O P
4:  Q R S T U
5:  V W X Y Z
Playable coordinate clue: 42 11 12 12 24 44
Decode the coordinate pairs and enter the recovered word.
puzzles.hint: Start with 42: row 4, column 2 points to R.

metadata.source_discrepancy: The supplied cropped digit clue does not decode to RABBIT using the shown standard checkerboard. The playable clue uses verified coordinates.
